dogecoin.text: @BeigeShiba Dogecoin unironically has more potential for that than Bitcoin. Bitcoin has too much overhead and is too vulnerable to being monopolized by a centralized chain of mainframes... Costs too high a percentage of it's valuation to keep the system running for it to be its own currency.
@HelloWo05491063 @stillgray That's why Dogecoin is the most viable alt-coin in my opinion. It's not trying to imitate Bitcoin in any capacity, so it actually has a potential niche.
@DaddyWarpig @craigbob99 This is why I laugh at the most common criticism of Dogecoin being that it's "not secure..." Thew least secure blockchain, is more secure than a coomer's inbox.
